subject: SIG/CAIQ artifacts: granular KMS/HSM rotation snapshots + transit proofs
messages:
From: Tom Reyes <t.reyes@finbridge.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: security@finbridge.com
Date: 2028-04-06T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SIG/CAIQ artifacts - keys/rotation/transit proofs

Hi Avery,

Thanks for taking the call earlier. As part of our SIG/CAIQ review for a production onboarding, our security team needs a compact artifact set covering encryption and key management controls. Specifically we need:

- Per-tenant key rotation snapshots (rotation events + operator id) for tenant FB-ACCT-923 for the last 12 months
- HSM operator access matrix and role separation evidence
- TLS/transit cipher inventory and proof of TLS config applied to inference endpoints
- Any signed attestation or manifest that shows the chain-of-custody for wrapped keys during transit (SFTP/S3 steps are fine)

We recognize some items may contain sensitive operator identifiers; let us know acceptable redaction rules. Delivery via a secure S3 presigned URL or customer-approved SFTP is fine. Can you confirm what you can provide and an estimated delivery date?

Best,
Tom Reyes
Director, Security Engineering
FinBridge Capital

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reyes <t.reyes@finbridge.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-06T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SIG/CAIQ artifacts - keys/rotation/transit proofs

Tom — thanks for the clear list. We can assemble a compact artifact package that covers everything you asked for. Quick notes on scope and approach: 

- Per-tenant rotation snapshots: we can export rotation event logs for FB-ACCT-923 covering key IDs, rotation timestamps, and operator IDs. We typically redact direct operator email addresses and replace with operator IDs; if you need full names we can provide them under an NDA/process.
- HSM operator access matrix: we'll include the operator role CSV and recent operator change events.
- TLS inventory: export of cipher suites and endpoint cert chains for the inference gateway (including regional endpoints) will be included.
- Chain-of-custody: we will include a signed manifest (PDF) describing the wrapping/unwrapping steps, transfer method, and checksums of the artifact bundle.

Proposed delivery: a single encrypted ZIP (AES-256) with a separate password over the phone or via a DocuSign-secured release. We can push to a presigned S3 URL that expires in 7 days. Target delivery: 2028-04-08 EOD PT.

Attaching a preliminary manifest we will populate: rotation-snapshots-tenant-FB-ACCT-923-2027.zip (placeholder), hsm-operator-access-matrix-2028.csv (placeholder), tls-cipher-inventory-2028.csv (placeholder).

Let us know any redaction rules (operator full names vs. IDs) and whether your procurement team needs an additional statement on retention windows.

Thanks,
Avery Johnson
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0198

--
Attachment stubs: rotation-snapshots-tenant-FB-ACCT-923-2027.zip (zip), hsm-operator-access-matrix-2028.csv (csv), tls-cipher-inventory-2028.csv (csv)

From: Tom Reyes <t.reyes@finbridge.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: security@finbridge.com, procurement@finbridge.com
Date: 2028-04-07T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SIG/CAIQ artifacts - keys/rotation/transit proofs

Avery — this looks good. A couple of clarifications from our security team: 

1) For operator identifiers we prefer operator IDs only (no PII). If we need names later we will request through legal.
2) The chain-of-custody manifest should include the exact presigned URL method and MD5/SHA256 checksums for each artifact.
3) We need the rotation events to include both the previous and new wrapped key IDs where possible (to validate lineage).

Procurement copied — if you could include a short note on retention policy (how long Redwood retains rotation logs and audit snapshots) that will help us close the SIG questionnaire.

If 2028-04-08 EOD PT is still the target, we will plan for an internal review on 2028-04-10. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

—Tom

Subject: Delivery plan and next steps — encryption artifact bundle for FB-ACCT-923

Tom / FinBridge team —

Per your clarifications, we will deliver the following by 2028-04-08 17:00 PT: 

- Encrypted artifact bundle: rotation-snapshots-tenant-FB-ACCT-923-2027.zip (contains CSV of rotation events with previous/new wrapped key IDs, timestamps, operator IDs only)
- HSM operator CSV: hsm-operator-access-matrix-2028.csv (operator IDs, roles, and recent change log)
- TLS inventory CSV: tls-cipher-inventory-2028.csv (endpoint, cert chain fingerprints, ciphers in use)
- Signed manifest PDF: redaction-index-and-manifest.pdf (includes transfer method, checksums, and retention note)

Delivery mechanism: we will upload to a time-limited S3 presigned URL and send the link to the security email. The ZIP will be AES-256 encrypted; password will be shared via phone or DocuSign-secured channel — please confirm preference.

Retention: rotation logs and audit snapshots are retained for 18 months by default; we can provide a one-time export beyond that window upon request with appropriate approvals. This will be noted in the manifest.

Irene and Marissa are looping to prepare the export and perform a final redaction pass (operator names -> IDs). Ben is standing by to coordinate the presigned URL and accompanying checksums.

If that plan works, we will send the presigned link and checksum manifest within the hour.

Thanks —
Avery Johnson
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
